reason: README Quick Start Method 2 evaluates a 0.5B local model on GSM8K with --limit 5, feasible on CPU with small downloads and no keys.
demo: README Quick Start, Method 2: Evaluate a Local Model (evalscope eval)
goal: Install evalscope (Python >= 3.11) and make `evalscope eval --model Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct --datasets gsm8k --limit 5` run to completion on CPU, with the model auto-downloaded from ModelScope and the GSM8K dataset fetched. It must accept a `--work-dir <dir>` option for outputs and finish by writing an evaluation report.
check: The hidden test runs the local-model GSM8K evaluation with limit 5 into a fresh output directory and verifies that a report file with a GSM8K score and 5 evaluated samples was produced.
